description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing audio effects within the Android audio framework, including EffectCallbackInterface, EffectBase, EffectModule, EffectHandle, EffectChain, and DeviceEffectProxy. It provides abstractions for effect lifecycle, effect processing, effect chains, and interaction with hardware effect HALs.

classes.name: EffectCallbackInterface
classes.description: Interface for effect callback operations, providing methods for effect creation, configuration, suspension, and state notifications.

classes.name: EffectBase
classes.description: Base class for audio effects, managing common properties, state, and handle management.

classes.name: EffectModule
classes.description: Wrapper controlling the effect engine implementation, managing effect processing, state, and client handles.

classes.name: EffectHandle
classes.description: Represents a client connection to an effect, managing control, parameters, and notifications.

classes.name: EffectChain
classes.description: Represents a group of effects associated with an audio session, managing effect order, suspension, and buffers.

classes.name: DeviceEffectProxy
classes.description: Proxy class for device-specific effects, managing effect creation, configuration, and interaction with hardware effect HAL.

methods.name: EffectModule::process
methods.description: Processes audio data through the effect.

methods.name: EffectChain::createEffect_l
methods.description: Creates and adds an effect to the chain.

methods.name: DeviceEffectProxy::setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the device effect proxy.
